Ostriches are sanctuary and pet animals. They are unlocked at reputation level 3.

Like all other sanctuary animals, players can only have four of them, one of each type.

Appearance

Ostriches have two different appearances: gray and brown.

Gray
Brown
Gray chick
Brown chick

Unlocking ostriches

Unlike other animals, ostriches cannot be bought. Players must unlock them by finding puzzle pieces (which are collected in a log book). 36 pieces are required for each animal.

Once players have obtained a first ostrich, the puzzle for the second ostrich is unlocked. After both adult ostriches have been added to the sanctuary, the puzzle for one of the chicks is unlocked.

Placing ostriches

Players must have an ostrich house to be able to place the animal in the sanctuary. The ostrich house is free and can be obtained from the Shop Shop.

When a second ostrich is added to the sanctuary, an upgraded ostrich house is obtained from the Shop. Upgrading does not cost anything. When the house is big enough to welcome a new animal, it is delivered in a crate, "airlifted" into the sanctuary by balloons.

Feeding ostrich

Ostriches are fed with wheat bundles. Once ostriches have eaten eat they roam the sanctuary for ten hours and finally fall asleep. Players can immediately wake them up to receive 25 xp per animal and a chance to get supplies. Ostriches stay asleep otherwise.

Ostriches which have been woken up but are not fed for a long while cannot fall asleep and wander around looking sleepy and tired.

  • Tip: Waking up sanctuary animals one by one instead of using a whistle may increase your chance of getting supplies.

Decorations

Each ostrich unlocks some decorations in the shop as specified below:

Espeletia (Gray)
Banana Plant (Brown)
Euphorbia Trigona (Gray chick)
Sicklebush (Brown chick)

With each animal players are given the first pair of decorations for free.
